content:
rachel: Quick sync  Solaris case study interview wrapped this morning. They gave a tight hero line, want logo + headshot use, and asked for a soft embargo until 2026-04-07 10:00 PDT. Need permission PDF and legal check for the comparative metric.

mike: Hero candidate: "With Redwood we saw a steady 30% reduction in inference spend and much more predictable tail latency across regions."

tara: I'll draft the landing copy, two social variants, and a 45s highlight clip. Planning: short landing + long form + webinar CTA.

jen: For legal: attach the transcript, proposed attribution (name + title), and confirm the exact baseline for the 30% number (time window). If it's a 90-day avg vs previous infra, we can reference that. Also need signed permission for logo + quote + headshot.

asset-bot: Transcript uploaded: /recordings/solaris-2026-03-24/transcript.v1.txt

mike: Attribution: "Priya Desai, Head of Data, Solaris Health". They prefer no email published. Baseline confirmed: 90-day avg vs prior infra.

jen: Good. Please upload the signed permission PDF when available. I'll aim for a rapid turnaround on the redline once I have the documents. If embargo is required, specify exact lift timestamp here so I can include it in the permission language.

leo: Lead routing plan: case study page will include a HubSpot form variant to capture webinar interest. Workflow: form submit -> set property cs_source=solaris -> add to list webinar-invite -> tag lead `cs:solaris-hot` if they click RSVP -> route to SF queue "CS - Solaris". Any objections?

tara: That works. Add utm_campaign=cs_solaris_apr and include hidden input for campaign name. Also let's set cookie expiry to 45 days for attribution.

rachel: Publish timeline: draft by Fri EOD, legal redline Mon, final approval Tue, publish Wed (2026-04-07). Webinar tentative 2026-04-21. Can the ops routing and form be live before publish so pre-signups can queue?

leo: Yes, we can create the page and keep it behind the embargo URL so the form works but the page is blocked via robots until publish. Will set the HubSpot form and the workflow this week.

mike: I'll send the permission PDF to Priya now for signature and confirm headshot usage (photo credit wording).

asset-bot: Permission PDF uploaded: /permissions/solaris/permission-signed-2026-03-24.pdf

jen: Received. I'll run the redline and post comments by Mon 11:00 PDT. If any language tweaks requested (e.g., change to "~30%"), I'll flag it.

tara: For hero testing, propose A/B variants: (A) performance-first (Mike's line), (B) product-first: "Redwood freed our engineers to focus on features, not infra ops." Test for 48h after publish.

rachel: Love the A/B test. Also create a variant of the landing with a short clip and one with a text-first format for fast-loading pages.

leo: Routing note for SDRs: prioritize `cs:solaris-hot` for webinar invites and tag converts `webinar:solaris_apr` in Salesforce. I'll add a short playbook in the SF queue description.

mike: Priya signed the permission PDF and approved the exact metric language. Uploading now.

asset-bot: Updated permission file: /permissions/solaris/permission-signed-2026-03-24-v2.pdf

jen: Reviewing v2 now. If all good I'll clear legal and we can move to final assets.

tara: I'll push drafts to the shared drive and drop the link here when ready. Expected EOD Fri.

rachel: Action items summary:
- mike: secure final signed permission + confirm headshot credit (done)
- tara: draft assets + share link (EOD Fri)
- jen: legal redline + approval (Mon 11:00 PDT)
- leo: HubSpot workflow + form + SF routing (this week)

rachel: tagging @here :sparkles: Let's aim to keep the embargo tight and the webinar list high quality. Thanks team.

asset-bot: Note: raw recording retained 90 days per retention policy.
